jobs.title: Senior SCADA-Systemintegrator / Software-Architekt (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unseren Kunden suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior SCADA-Systemintegrator / Software-Architekten (m/w/d) für einen zunächst sechsmonatigen Projekteinsatz mit Option auf Verlängerung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Konzeption und Umsetzung skalierbarer SCADA- und Visualisierungslösungen. Dabei bringen Sie Ihre technische Expertise ein und arbeiten eng mit weiteren Spezialisten im Projektteam zusammen.
Der Einsatz erfolgt im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung ODER als Freelancer, vermittelt über Tintschl Technik GmbH. Sie können größtenteils remote arbeiten; lediglich gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine in Hilden (NRW) sind vorgesehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

SCADA-Architektur: Konzeption und Entwicklung eines übergeordneten zentralen SCADA-Leitsystems zur Überwachung und Bedienung einer großen Anzahl dezentraler Anlagen
Datenanbindung und Kommunikation: Anbindung und performante Aggregation von Live-Daten aus Siemens S7-1500 Steuerungen über OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104 und/oder Modbus TCP
Visualisierung und Bedienung: Entwicklung eines zentralen, mandantenfähigen HMI- und Dashboard-Systems zur Darstellung von Kapazitäten, Ladezuständen und Anlagenstatus sowie zur manuellen Bedienung relevanter Funktionen
Alarm- und Event-Management: Entwicklung eines skalierbaren Meldesystems mit intelligenter Filterung und Priorisierung, um kritische Fehler schnell zu lokalisieren und eine Überflutung der Leitwarte mit Meldungen zu vermeiden
Datenarchitektur: Konzeption und Implementierung geeigneter Lösungen zur Speicherung, Verarbeitung und Auswertung großer Mengen hochfrequenter Telemetrie- und Betriebsdaten
Kennzahlen und Analysen: Entwicklung technischer und betriebswirtschaftlicher KPIs, unter anderem zu State of Health, Verfügbarkeit, Zyklenzahl und Temperatur-Ausreißern auf Einzelanlagen- und Gesamtbestandsebene
Automatisiertes Reporting: Entwicklung eines Reporting-Moduls zur automatischen Erstellung und Versendung wöchentlicher und monatlicher Betriebsberichte, beispielsweise als PDF oder Excel
Zusammenarbeit an den Schnittstellen: Enge Abstimmung mit der OT-Netzwerkarchitektur, um das Zusammenspiel zwischen automatisierter VPN-Infrastruktur und zentraler SCADA-Datenkommunikation sicher und skalierbar zu gestalten

Ihr Profil

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Implementierung zentraler SCADA-Leitsysteme, idealerweise in einer vergleichbaren Senior- oder Architekturrolle
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau)
Fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit mindestens einer der Plattformen Siemens WinCC OA, WinCC Unified oder Ignition SCADA
Erfahrung in der Anbindung von Siemens S7-1500 Steuerungen sowie mit industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen wie OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104 und/oder Modbus TCP
Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von HMI- und Dashboard-Lösungen sowie im Aufbau skalierbarer Alarm- und Event-Management-Systeme
Erfahrung mit Datenarchitekturen zur Verarbeitung und Auswertung großer Mengen hochfrequenter Betriebsdaten
Gutes mathematisch-technisches Verständnis zur Berechnung und Bewertung batteriespeicherspezifischer KPIs
Erfahrung mit Reporting- und Visualisierungslösungen wie Dream Report, WinCC OA Reporting Tools oder Grafana sowie mit SQL-Datenbanken und entsprechenden Schnittstellen von Vorteil
Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, sich eng mit anderen technischen Spezialisten abzustimmen

Das bieten wir Ihnen

Übertarifliche Vergütung
inklusive attraktiver Zuschläge
Auszeichnungen
, die für sich sprechen – unter anderem Kununu Top Company 2026 und FOCUS Top Nationaler Arbeitgeber 2026

Steigendes Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
innerhalb der ersten vier Beschäftigungsjahre
Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Prämie

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du konzipierst und verantwortest Ende-zu-Ende-Teststrategien über alle Ebenen hinweg – Unit-, Integrations-, System-, UI-, Stress- und Performance-Tests – für unsere medizinischen Softwareprodukte.
Du baust und entwickelst Test-Harnesses und CI-Pipelines weiter, die Regressionen früh erkennen, stabil und skalierbar laufen und unseren C++-Desktop-, .NET- und modernen Web-Stacks schnelles, verlässliches Feedback liefern.
Du planst, implementierst und analysierst Last- und Performance-Tests, identifizierst Engpässe und Stabilitätsrisiken und treibst gemeinsam mit den Entwicklerteams messbare Qualitätsverbesserungen voran.
Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Architektur und Produktmanagement zusammen, agierst als Qualitäts-Gewissen des Teams und verankerst testgetriebene "Shift-Left"-Engineering-Praktiken.
Du nutzt AI-Agents und Tools wie Claude Code gezielt, um Tests zu generieren, zu pflegen und zu triagieren, und baust wiederverwendbare Automatisierungs-Skills und Workflows für die gesamte QA-Community auf.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung auf Senior-Level mit tiefem Verständnis für mehrschichtige Testframeworks sowie erprobte Praxis in Last- und Performance-Tests, idealerweise in regulierten oder sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen.
Exzellenter Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studium mit sehr guten Noten.
Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer Sprache wie C#, Java, Python oder TypeScript; Praxis mit modernen Test-Tools (z. B. Ranorex, Playwright, Cypress), Versionsverwaltung und CI/CD (z. B. GitLab CI), ISTQB oder gleichwertige Zertifizierungen ist ein Plus.
Nachweislich effektiver Einsatz von AI in QA-Workflows; idealerweise Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder ähnlichen agentischen Coding-Tools (Agents, Skills, Workflows) sowie mit AI-Pipelines, Test Harnesses und Context Engineering.
Verhandlungssicherheit Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift, starke Problemlösungsfähigkeit, Innovationsfreude, ausgeprägte Proaktivität, unternehmerisches Mindset und hohe Qualitätsansprüche im Sinne einer modernen, patientenorientierten Healthcare-IT.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Entwicklung: Unsere Inhouse-Academy und unser Portfolio aus externen Kooperationspartnern unterstützen Dich in Deiner Weiterentwicklung.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV u. V. M. Für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Überzeugt?
Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

Netwrix Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide. Experience with modern databases and frameworks in high-performance scenarios, such as PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core

jobs.description:
W naszym projekcie nie piszesz kodu od zera. Jesteś osobą - pilotem, która nadzoruje agentów AI generujących architekturę 3-warstwową na podstawie User Stories. Twoim głównym zadaniem jest Code Review kodu generowanego przez AI, dbanie o czystość architektury (Clean Code) oraz rozwiązywanie problemów, które wykraczają poza możliwości obecnych modeli LLM.

Profil stanowiska

Doświadczenie w budowaniu skalowalnych aplikacji Full-stack (stos: .NET 8, C#, EF oraz Angular 21/TypeScript)
Zmysł architektoniczny – umiejętność korygowania błędów AI w strukturze 3-warstwowej
Umiejętność pracy z narzędziami typu Agentic AI (np. Claude Code) i zrozumienie Agentic Workflow
Solidna wiedza o bazach danych (MS SQL Server) – sprawne mapowanie danych przy przejściu z legacy

Twoje zadania

Nadzór nad generacją kodu poprzez instruowanie agentów AI w celu uzyskania optymalnej implementacji
Zaawansowane Code Review pod kątem bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i skalowalności kodu z AI
Integracja systemowa: Łączenie nowej warstwy webowej z logiką biznesową legacy poprzez stabilne API
Debugowanie "edge cases": Rozwiązywanie skomplikowanych błędów, z którymi AI sobie nie radzi

Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych
System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy
Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura)
Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace
Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT
Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer to take ownership of QA for a complex solution combining data processing, AI, and optimization components. The system processes diverse and often incomplete input data, with some components producing non-deterministic results and others relying on mathematical optimization. The solution includes backend and frontend components, automated data pipelines, and PDF generation, creating an interesting mix of functional, integration, performance, and quality challenges. This is a hands-on senior role where you will shape the QA strategy and automation approach, define quality standards, and help ensure reliable releases.

What You Will Do:

Own and evolve the QA strategy, including test levels, risk-based testing, environments, test data, defect classification, and release criteria.
Design and develop automated tests in Python using pytest, covering APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and batch processing.
Build frontend automation with Playwright or a comparable tool, integrate automated tests into CI pipelines, and develop PDF regression testing, including visual comparison and PDF/X-3 validation.
Create synthetic and rule-based test data, cover data quality issues and edge cases, and apply property-based testing approaches such as Hypothesis.
Design and execute performance and volume tests, including parallel processing, analyse runtime and quality metrics in Grafana, and test scaling in AWS EKS.
Perform exploratory and release testing, monitor quality trends and regressions, and optionally explore AI-assisted testing, including LLM-based automation..

Requirements:

Senior-level QA experience, including previous ownership of QA in at least one project.
Hands-on experience independently creating and implementing a test concept/test strategy.
Strong Python and pytest test automation skills.
Experience configuring and maintaining automated tests in CI pipelines.
Strong experience testing backend and data-oriented systems, including APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and batch processing.
Experience generating synthetic or rule-based test data.
Experience with runtime, performance, and volume testing of backend or batch systems, including parallel processing.
Ability to design performance scenarios, define relevant metrics, and analyse bottlenecks.
Frontend test automation experience with Playwright or a comparable tool.
Manual and exploratory testing experience.
Practical knowledge of defect classification, severity levels, and release criteria.
Fluent English.

German language skills.

jobs.title: Senior Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
📍 hybrid work - 3 days/week from the office

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Microservices architecture and system design
Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
Monitoring and observability practices

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer - Automotive & Cloud
jobs.description:
NET Backend Developer - Automotive & Cloud

Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens uppkopplade fordon och digitala mobilitetstjänster?

CGI i Göteborg söker erfarna .NET Backend Developers som vill arbeta med modern backendutveckling hos några av Sveriges ledande företag inom fordonsindustrin.

Hos oss får du arbeta i teknikintensiva uppdrag där du utvecklar affärskritiska system, molnbaserade plattformar, API:er och backendtjänster för nästa generations fordon och digitala ekosystem.

Du blir en del av agila och tvärfunktionella team där samarbete, innovation och hög teknisk kvalitet står i centrum.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

Som .NET Backend Developer kommer du bland annat att:

Utveckla moderna backendlösningar och mikrotjänster i C#/.NET.
Designa och implementera REST API:er och integrationslösningar.
Utveckla skalbara och säkra molnbaserade applikationer.
Arbeta med databaser, event-driven arkitektur och integrationsplattformar.
Delta i teknisk design och arkitekturdiskussioner.
Säkerställa kvalitet genom automatiserade tester och CI/CD.
Arbeta tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra specialister i agila team.
Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av teknik, arbetssätt och utvecklingsprocesser.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som har:

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av backendutveckling.
Goda kunskaper i C# och .NET/.NET Core.
Erfarenhet av REST API och integrationsutveckling.
Erfarenhet av SQL och databaser såsom SQL Server eller PostgreSQL.
Erfarenhet av Git, automatiserade tester och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.
Erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmetoder.
God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

Microsoft Azure eller andra molnplattformar.
Docker och Kubernetes.
Azure Service Bus, Kafka eller andra messagingplattformar.
Microservices och event-driven architecture.
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions eller andra CI/CD-lösningar.
Entity Framework.
Redis, MongoDB eller andra NoSQL-databaser.
OAuth2, OpenID Connect och Microsoft Entra ID.
Automotive, connected vehicles, telematik eller andra verksamhetskritiska system.

Vi tror att du är lösningsorienterad och nyfiken på modern teknik. Du uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och tar ansvar för kvaliteten i det du utvecklar.

Därför ska du välja CGI

På CGI i Göteborg får du arbeta i några av Sveriges mest spännande utvecklingsprojekt inom automotive och digitalisering. Vi kombinerar den globala organisationens möjligheter med det lokala teamets närhet och gemenskap.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med modern backendutveckling, Azure och komplexa digitala lösningar samtidigt som du utvecklas genom nya uppdrag, kompetensutveckling och certifieringar.

Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetsformer och en kultur där samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i centrum.

Godkänd bakgrundskontroll kommer att krävas för denna tjänst.

Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens digitala mobilitet tillsammans med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan! Om du har några frågor kring tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta anders.haggdahl@cgi.com. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Software Architect with a strong background in C#/.NET and a passion for building solutions that make a real difference? Join us at Epiroc and help shape the architecture behind innovative digital solutions for sustainable mining and construction. In this role, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with the ability to guide, mentor and bring others forward.

It all starts with people. People like you.

Join our team

You will join an IoT Platform organization - an international, diverse, and highly collaborative environment where software developers, architects, and product owners work side‑by‑side to enable the next generation of data‑driven solutions. Together, we build the platform that collects machine data and transforms it into real value for customers and internal stakeholders across Epiroc.

Your mission

First our product manager(s) define “the What”. Then a key part in this architect role will be to contribute with “the How”. Your mission is to take an active role in shaping and developing the software architecture within the teams while also staying close to the development work. You will work for solutions that are well designed, sustainable and aligned with both current and future needs. Together with our Lead Architect and fellow architect colleagues you will form a strong architectural team that relentlessly implements and follows up on a solid architectural roadmap and ways of working. This role will start to focus on one of our development teams and then gradually expand its responsibility towards several teams.

In this role, you will:

Drive and contribute to good software architecture
Support architectural discussions and technical decision-making
Be involved in creating the architectural style and then heavily contributing towards the architectural patterns, design patterns and design principles
Designs end-to-end IT solutions that align with business goals
Work with C#/.NET IoT solutions such as file transfer, device management & data handling and more towards cloud rather than machine
Collaborate closely with developers, teams and other internal stakeholders
Contribute to continuous improvement and bring new perspectives into the team
Balance hands-on contribution with guiding others in their technical development
Designs software components and modules
Set coding standards
Solve technical challenges like code scalability, maintainability, security and performance

Your profile

You enjoy collaborating with others, sharing your knowledge and helping the team move forward while still contributing strongly to the technical delivery. You bring solid software architecture experience, new perspectives and a positive, engaging approach.

We believe you have:

At least 5 years of experience as a software architect or in software development with a lead role in software architecture matters
Experience working in roles where you have contributed to architectural direction, technical design, senior-level development or set up complex foundations that other teams could built their deliveries upon
Very strong knowledge in C#/.NET
The ability and interest to support developers
Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset
A positive and engaging approach

Location and other

This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. While we offer a hybrid workplace, you would be required to be in the office minimum of 3 days per week.

Why Epiroc?

By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth and lasting impact.

To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:

Global career opportunities
Learning & Development programs
Benefits package, including variable compensation
Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
Global Parental Leave Policy
Community involvement

Application and contact information

We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 23, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date.

We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

For questions about the position, please contact:

Hiring Manager, Carl Slotte, carl.slotte@external.epiroc.com

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact:

Recruitment Specialist, Zuzana Matova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com

It all starts with people.
The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

Sommaren börjar släppa taget och hösten närmar sig. Tempot skruvas upp igen, vardagen hittar tillbaka till sina rutiner – och kanske gör också tankarna på vad du vill framåt det.

Med några månader kvar av året kan det vara ett bra tillfälle att fundera över nästa steg. Kanske trivs du där du är, eller så börjar det kännas som att det är dags för något nytt. Ett nytt sammanhang, nya utmaningar eller helt enkelt en förändring inför nästa år.

Om de tankarna känns bekanta kanske det är hos Nexer som ditt nästa kapitel börjar.

Som konsult på Nexer får du arbeta med varierande uppdrag inom olika tekniker och branscher. Hos oss är varje uppdrag en chans att växa – vi tror stenhårt på utveckling. Vi tror också på en hållbar och långsiktig anställning, där kompetensutveckling och balans mellan arbete och fritid är självklara delar av vardagen.

Vem är du?

På Nexer i Jönköping fortsätter vi att bygga vårt team – nu söker vi erfarna Cloud & DevOps Engineers.

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och skapa moderna och hållbara molnlösningar för kunder inom olika branscher. Våra kunder finns inom bland annat industri, offentlig sektor och teknikintensiva verksamheter. Gemensamt för dem är att de står inför stora förändringsresor där molntjänster, automation, säkerhet och moderna utvecklingsplattformar är en viktig del av framtiden.

Som konsult hos oss blir du en del av ett team med hög kompetens och stort engagemang. Du arbetar i varierande uppdrag hos olika kunder där du får kombinera teknik, problemlösning och samarbete med både utvecklingsteam och verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar att sätta dig in i nya miljöer, bygga relationer och skapa värde oavsett kundens tekniska plattform eller organisation.

Exempel på uppdrag

Bygga och vidareutveckla molnbaserade applikationer och plattformar
Modernisera befintliga system och migrera dem till molnet
Utforma lösningar med fokus på skalbarhet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet
Automatisera infrastruktur med Infrastructure as Code
Sätta upp CI/CD-flöden och automatiserade leveransprocesser
Arbeta med containers och Kubernetes-plattformar
Utveckla plattformar och arbetssätt som stärker utvecklingsteamens leveransförmåga
Arbeta med säkerhet, governance och kostnadsoptimering i molnmiljöer
Samarbeta med kunders utvecklings-, drift- och verksamhetsteam

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av

Minst en större molnplattform, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller GCP
Backend-utveckling i exempelvis .NET, Java, Node.js eller Python
Containers och orkestrering (Docker, Kubernetes)
Versionshantering och CI/CD-verktyg (Git, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps eller Jenkins)
Infrastruktur som kod (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, ARM eller motsvarande)
Grundläggande säkerhetsprinciper i molnmiljöer, exempelvis IAM, secrets management och nätverk

Det är ett stort plus om du också har

Erfarenhet av serverless-lösningar, exempelvis Azure Functions eller AWS Lambda
Erfarenhet av observability och övervakning, exempelvis Datadog, Grafana eller Prometheus
Erfarenhet av Platform Engineering och utvecklarplattformar
Erfarenhet av större molnmigreringar eller transformationsprojekt
Certifieringar inom AWS, Azure, Kubernetes eller GCP

Vi söker dig som inte bara gillar teknik, utan också konsultrollen. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i nya verksamheter, bygga relationer och hjälpa olika kunder att hitta hållbara lösningar. Oavsett om du är specialist inom ett område eller har en bred teknisk profil tror vi att du drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med både kunder och kollegor.

Rollen kräver att du obehindrat kan kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Det är en viktig förutsättning för att lyckas i kunddialoger och i samarbetet med teamet.

Eftersom rollen innebär konsultuppdrag hos olika kunder ser vi också att du trivs med att arbeta i varierande miljöer. Resor förekommer i vissa uppdrag och därför är det en fördel om du är bekväm med ett visst mått av resande.

Tjänsten är placerad i Jönköping.

Vilka är vi på Nexer i Jönköping?

Hos Nexer i Jönköping får du arbeta i spännande och utvecklande uppdrag inom både offentlig och privat sektor. Vi samarbetar med verksamheter inom några av de mest teknikdrivna branscherna, exempelvis automotive, försvar och automatiserad industri.

Vi tror på kraften i mångfald och på att olika perspektiv skapar starkare team och bättre lösningar. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av det lokala teamet, där vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap, trygghet och tillhörighet. Vi vill skapa rätt förutsättningar för att du ska kunna utvecklas utifrån dina drivkrafter, ambitioner och mål.

Våra värderingar – Passion & Execution – genomsyrar vårt sätt att arbeta och samarbeta, både med kunder och med varandra.

Uppdragen genomförs antingen hos kund, i Nexers egna lokaler eller hemifrån – ofta i en flexibel hybridlösning. I vissa uppdrag arbetar du självständigt, i andra blir du en del av ett team tillsammans med flera kollegor från Nexer.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Cloud & SaaS Integrations
jobs.description:
Location

Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
Working proficiency in SQL
Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

Unlimited Vacation
Flexible Working Options
Health Insurance
Parental Leave
Employee Stock Option Plan
Home Office Allowance
Professional Development Stipend
Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team , where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

Location

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface

Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)

AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles

Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)

jobs.title: Senior backendutvikler med C#/.NET-erfaring
jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med backend-utvikling på C#/.NET, liker å ta tekniske valg og trigges av å løse komplekse problemer i systemer som betyr mye for mange? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.
I Telenor bygger vi nye løsninger – men minst like viktig er jobben med å videreutvikle, forenkle og modernisere systemene som allerede er en viktig del av virksomheten vår. Du blir en del av et faglig sterkt miljø hvor du får mulighet til å påvirke både arkitektur, teknologi og hvordan vi jobber med modernisering fremover.

Du vil jobbe i et backend-miljø som forvalter og moderniserer løsninger med høy betydning for Telenors kunder, drift og interne prosesser. Det betyr at du både får jobbe med nyutvikling og med smarte forbedringer av systemer som allerede er i aktiv bruk.

Hva skal du jobbe med?

Som senior utvikler vil du jobbe hands-on med utvikling, samtidig som du får en viktig rolle i de tekniske diskusjonene i teamet.
Du vil blant annet få:
utvikle og videreutvikle løsninger basert på C# og .NET
bidra til modernisering av eksisterende systemer og tjenester
være med på å ta og dokumentere arkitekturbeslutninger
utfordre eksisterende løsninger og foreslå bedre og enklere måter å gjøre ting på
jobbe med databaser og datamodeller i MSSQL
utvikle og drifte løsninger på OpenShift
bidra til automatisering av deployment og moderne CI/CD-praksis
samarbeide tett med utviklere, tech leads og andre fagmiljøer i Telenor

Vi ønsker ikke bare noen som kan skrive god kode. Vi ser etter deg som også er nysgjerrig på hvorfor vi bygger ting slik vi gjør – og hvordan vi kan gjøre dem bedre.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har bred erfaring med systemutvikling og har stått i tekniske valg over tid. Rundt 10 års relevant erfaring kan være et godt utgangspunkt, men kvaliteten og bredden i erfaringen din er viktigere enn et bestemt antall år. Det er en fordel om du har jobbet i flere ulike selskaper eller teknologimiljøer. Da har du sannsynligvis sett at det finnes mer enn én måte å løse et problem på – og kanskje også erfart hvilke løsninger man helst ikke bør gjenta. Som en bonus må du gjerne kunne litt, eller ha lyst til å lære, Typescript/React frontend, men det er ikke et krav til stillingen.

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:

har solid erfaring med C# og .NET
har erfaring med MSSQL
er komfortabel med å delta i og drive frem arkitektur- og teknologibeslutninger
kjenner moderne prinsipper for softwareutvikling og systemarkitektur
har erfaring med containerbaserte plattformer, gjerne OpenShift
er interessert i modernisering, refaktorering og gradvis forbedring av eksisterende systemer
evner å balansere teknisk kvalitet, kompleksitet og forretningsbehov
liker å dele kunnskap og diskutere løsninger med andre

Har du i tillegg erfaring med ArgoCD og GitOps, er det et klart pluss.

Vi ønsker utviklere som tør å stille spørsmål, utfordre etablerte sannheter og bidra til at vi hele tiden blir litt bedre. Du trenger ikke komme inn døren med alle svarene, men vi håper du kommer inn med erfaring, nysgjerrighet og lysten til å finne dem sammen med oss.

Mer om teamet og løsningene våre

Du blir en del av TFS-teamet - Technical Field Services. Vi utvikler digitale arbeidsverktøy for teknikere og entreprenører som bygger, drifter og vedlikeholder Telenors nett. Løsningene våre gjør det mulig å utføre flere oppgaver selvbetjent ute i felt og knytter sammen app, web og backend med sentrale arbeidsordre-, nettverks- og leveransesystemer. Teamet er tverrfaglig og består av backend-, frontend- og fullstackutviklere, design, test, produktledelse og tech lead. Vi arbeider sammen fra innsikt og brukerbehov til arkitektur, utvikling, produksjonssetting og drift.
Det vi bygger har målbar effekt. TFS brukes blant annet til selvbetjent arbeid på mobilsite, digital skaderapportering og enklere aktivering av kundeutstyr. Resultatet er mindre manuelt arbeid, raskere feilretting, bedre datakvalitet og kortere vei fra hendelse til handling.
Som senior backend-utvikler vil du arbeide med domenemodeller, API-er, integrasjoner, dataflyt og robuste tjenester i et komplekst systemlandskap. Du får både modernisere løsninger med lang historie og være med på å utvikle nye kapabiliteter for fremtidens arbeid i felt.

Modernisering er mer enn å bytte teknologi

Noe av det mest spennende med rollen er at du kommer inn i et miljø hvor løsningene allerede har en historie. Her handler modernisering ikke om å kaste alt og begynne på nytt. Det handler derimot om å forstå hvorfor systemene ser ut som de gjør, finne ut hva som fortsatt fungerer godt, identifisere hva som bør endres og gjennomføre forbedringene på en trygg og bærekraftig måte. Det krever både teknisk erfaring, nysgjerrighet og en god porsjon pragmatisme.
Og det er nettopp den kombinasjonen vi ser etter.

Praktisk informasjon

Stillingen krever sikkerhetsklarering i Norge

jobs.title: Solution Architect | AI & Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
Vær med å forme fremtidens Dynamics 365-løsninger med AI

I Cepheo hjelper vi virksomheter med å lykkes med digital transformasjon gjennom forretningsløsninger, data-, sky- og AI-løsninger basert på Microsoft Dynamics 365 plattformen. Med kunder på tvers av bransjer og sterke fagmiljøer i hele Norden jobber vi tett med kundene våre, fra strategi og implementering til videreutvikling og verdiskaping.

AI er i ferd med å endre måten virksomheter bruker forretningssystemer på. Som Microsoft-partner ønsker vi å ligge i front av denne utviklingen, og vi investerer betydelig i kompetanse innen områder som Copilot, AI-agenter, automatisering og intelligente forretningsprosesser.

Nå søker vi en Solution Architect - AI & Dynamcis 365 som ønsker å kombinere erfaring fra Dynamics 365 med en spesialisering innen kunstig intelligens. Rollen passer for deg som har noen års erfaring med Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations / Business Central) eller tilsvarende løsninger, og som ønsker å ta neste steg mot en arkitektrolle med AI som faglig spisskompetanse.

Om rollen

Som Solution Architect - AI & Dynamics 365 vil du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom Dynamics 365, Microsoft AI-teknologi og kundenes forretningsprosesser.

Du vil bidra til å designe fremtidige løsninger hvor AI, Copilot og automatisering er en naturlig del av brukeropplevelsen og arbeidsprosessene. Samtidig vil du få muligheten til å bygge dyp kompetanse innen Microsofts AI-teknologier gjennom kundeprosjekter, interne prosjekter, fagmiljøer og samarbeid med våre AI-spesialister i Norden.

Dette er en rolle for deg som er teknologisk nysgjerrig, liker å forstå hvordan systemer henger sammen, og som ønsker å vokse inn i en sentral arkitektrolle.

Du vil blant annet jobbe med

Designe og videreutvikle løsninger basert på Dynamics 365 og Microsoft-plattformen
Identifisere hvordan AI kan skape verdi i ERP- og forretningsprosesser, både internt i Cepheo og ut mot kunder
Utforske og implementere løsninger basert på Copilot, AI-agenter og automatisering
Løsningsarkitektur i kundeprosjekter
Analysere kundebehov og omsette disse til fremtidsrettede løsninger
Være bindeledd mellom forretning, prosesser og teknologi
Workshops og kundedialog knyttet til AI og Dynamics 365
Bygge kompetanse innen Microsoft AI, Power Platform, Copilot og Azure AI Services
Bidra til å utvikle Cepheos AI-satsning og metodikk

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har erfaring fra en eller flere av følgende roller:

Minst 3 års erfaring med Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central eller tilsvarende ERP-løsninger, fra partner- eller kundesiden
God forståelse for forretningsprosesser, for eksempel innen økonomi, logistikk, innkjøp eller produksjon
Erfaring med å snakke med både forretningsfolk og teknikere, og å få dem til å forstå hverandre
Et genuint engasjement for AI og for hvordan det kan forbedre både kundens og våre egne prosesser
God muntlig og skriftlig kommunikasjon på norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, og på engelsk
Erfaring med løsningsdesign eller arkitektur
Prøvd Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure OpenAI eller lignende, i jobb eller på eget initiativ
Relevante sertifiseringer, for eksempel PL-600, MB-700 eller AI-102

Det viktigste for oss

Du trenger ikke være AI-ekspert i dag.

Det viktigste er at du har en solid bakgrunn innen Dynamics 365 eller tilsvarende løsninger, er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI vil endre måten virksomheter jobber på, og har lyst til å utvikle deg til å bli en av Cepheos fremtidige løsningsarkitekter innen AI og løsningsarkitektur.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å kombinere det beste fra Dynamics 365-verdenen med den mest spennende teknologiske utviklingen fra Microsoft.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät erilaisten ihmisten ja ajatusten kohdatessa.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinto, finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistava teollisuus. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluita, joita ihmiset käyttävät päivittäin – ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi

Kokemusta .NET- ja/tai React-kehityksestä sekä integraatioista
Kokemusta Azure Functions- ja Logic Apps -ratkaisuista sekä DevOps-ympäristöistä
Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for the next step in your career? At Deloitte Engineering, we are looking for recent graduates and early-career software developers who want to strengthen their technical and problem-solving capabilities while helping us grow our Engineering practice. You will have the opportunity to work hands-on with software development while applying your skills in a consulting environment, working with clients to solve complex business and technology challenges.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Technology & Transformation.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, architects, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software developer. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a software developer at the Engineering offering, you will work with many different aspects of development, from writing code to testing it. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development.
Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.
Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.
Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You hold a Master’s degree, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Development, or another relevant technical field. You are either a recent graduate or have up to 4 years of full-time professional experience, preferably within software development. Experience from student positions, internships, or part-time software development roles is also considered an advantage.
You enjoy applying your analytical and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and are motivated by working both hands-on with software and in a client-facing consulting environment. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

Experience in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.
Some experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.
Some experience with modern system design and software architecture principles.
You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.
You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.
You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte.
Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:
Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.
Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.
The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories.
Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Click the "I am interested" button
above
if you are ready to join our team.
Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.
Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027.

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any
questions about the position.

arbejde med integrationer, databaser og forretningskritiske dataflows.
bidrage til tekniske beslutninger og løbende forbedringer.

samarbejde tæt med udviklere, product management og forretningen.
anvende AI-værktøjer og moderne udviklingsmetoder i hverdagen.

har erfaring med backend-udvikling i .NET/C#.
har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og databaser.
har erfaring med moderne softwareudvikling og god kodekvalitet.
har arbejdet med cloud-platforme/AWS.
arbejder struktureret med Git, test og samarbejde omkring kode.
er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og AI-understøttet softwareudvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du også har erfaring med:
JavaScript eller TypeScript.
React eller andre moderne frontend-frameworks.
messaging og eventbaserede arkitekturer.
GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes og Terraform.
Power Platform, Dynamics og Umbraco.

Hvem håber vi, du er?
Du er typen, der:
får tingene til at ske uden at skulle have alting perfekt på forhånd.
er nysgerrig og har lyst til hele tiden at lære nyt.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. Job Description

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.
Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

What you bring to the team:

You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.
You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.
You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.
Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.
The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories.

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

at soolsen@deloitte.dk

About Teradyne

Teradyne is a leading supplier of Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) used to test complex electronics in the consumer electronics, automotive, computing, telecommunications, aerospace, and defense industries. Teradyne helps bring high-quality innovations in smart devices, life-saving medical equipment, and data storage systems to market faster through its advanced test solutions for semiconductors and electronic systems.

In 2023, Teradyne generated $2.7 billion in revenue and employed approximately 6,500 people worldwide.

The Semiconductor Test Division is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor test equipment for logic, RF, analog, power, mixed-signal, and memory technologies. The Nextest division is responsible for the Magnum family of memory test products.

For more information, visit www.teradyne.com .

Our Purpose

At Teradyne, experience meets innovation as we drive excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity, diversity of thought, and the strength of our workforce. Our employees are driven to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate an inclusive culture that respects each employee’s strengths, perspectives, and experiences. We believe our differences make us a stronger team—one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers stronger business results.

Organization & Role

Nextest is looking for software engineers to join an exciting, dynamic, hardworking, engaging, and collaborative team. As an individual contributor, you will be involved in all aspects of software engineering and complex problem-solving, working with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and test new features and functionality.

Nextest engineering teams bring deep technical expertise across both software and hardware. Our engineers thrive in a dynamic, customer-driven, global work environment where they succeed through innovation and collaboration. Internally, we work closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and QA. Externally, we partner with Field Support and customers to deliver impactful solutions.

Opportunity Overview

In this role, you will:

Understand customer requirements and find innovative ways to incorporate them into our existing software architecture.
Learn from our most senior engineers while bringing your own experience and perspective to help drive the next generation of Teradyne solutions.
Collaborate with our senior team to design and develop programs and libraries for new products.
Assist with sustaining and extending programs and libraries for existing products.
Engage with our Field Applications team to find innovative ways to improve customer success and solve customer problems.
Work with the Software QA group to develop effective test strategies, identify improvement areas, and resolve issues in internal and customer-facing software releases.

All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
Expert-level proficiency in C++ and/or C# with strong object-oriented design and programming skills.
Strong experience developing software that interfaces directly with hardware, including FPGA-, ASIC-, or instrument-based systems.
Solid hands-on experience with .NET application development.
Strong understanding of software quality practices, including unit testing, automated testing, and continuous integration methodologies.
Proficiency in Windows application development and debugging using Microsoft Visual Studio.
Strong knowledge of the C++ Standard Template Library (STL) and modern C++ development practices.
Experience with source code management and collaborative development tools, including Git/GitLab, code review processes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Jira or similar Agile project management tools for requirement tracking, sprint planning, and issue management.
Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring engineering teams.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to cross-functional teams.
Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
Good command of written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience collaborating with hardware engineering teams, including interpreting schematics, hardware specifications, and design documentation.
Experience developing Windows device drivers, particularly using the Kernel-Mode Driver Framework (KMDF).
Strong understanding of Windows operating system internals and low-level system programming.
Proven track record of successfully delivering commercial products to customers.
Experience with instrument control, measurement systems, or test equipment software development.
Experience in Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems, preferably in semiconductor memory testing.
Experience developing Windows-based GUI applications using WPF, MFC, or similar frameworks.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Multi-threaded and high-performance software development.
Software architecture and system-level design experience.
Experience with distributed systems, data analytics, or test data processing.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

About The Airwallex Intern Program

Gain hands-on experience through owning your own project end to end
Benefit from personal mentorship by industry leading technologists
Rare software engineering intern experience where you are hands-on with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted workflows
Join a cohort experience that fosters knowledge sharing, networking and soft skill development
Many of our Interns receive an Airwallex Graduate role at intern program completion We are looking for talented, curious and determined individuals to join our 12-week Software Engineering Intern Program commencing in May 2027.

About The Team

The Engineering team at Airwallex is a diverse group of innovators, builders, and problem solvers, driven by a mission to empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. We thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, where we're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the financial technology space.

As a team, we value technical craftsmanship, continuous learning and a strong sense of ownership, and we believe modern engineers should know how to work effectively with AI. We build scalable, reliable and secure products that empower businesses to grow without borders, and we want interns who are excited to explore LLM-powered tools thoughtfully, apply sound engineering judgement, and stay current with the fast-moving AI landscape.

What You'll Do

As an intern, you will be given an exciting and challenging project that you'll start in week 1. You'll join our structured Intern Program, be set up with a mentor and manager to make sure you have the best experience and that you are encouraged and supported to contribute. Most importantly, we want you to feel part of the team and learn lots while you are working with us!

Our leaders welcome all Airwallex people to contribute to our roadmap and to constantly challenge the processes that we build our platforms through. You'll get the opportunity to learn and apply best-practice software engineering, focusing on strong software engineering fundamentals and pragmatism from our engineers.

You will learn how AI can enhance strong engineering by using LLM tools for research, prototyping, debugging, testing and documentation, while applying critical judgement and strong fundamentals. Working on ambitious goals with a modern stack including Kotlin, Kafka, Kubernetes and React, you will help deliver simple, scalable solutions while exploring new models and tooling with your team.

12 weeks over the Singapore University summer break (start early May to late Jul)
1st week in a structured induction
3 Program Review / Check-Ins across the 12 week program
1 Intern scoped Project to own end to end
1 Project Showcase to present back to our Teams on what you built

About You

You can think on your feet - with knowledge of building platforms which resolve fast paced, ever changing success measures
You are a team player - you enjoy working in a collaborative, innovative and customer first environment
You are naturally curious - always asking why to better understand our customer needs
You are a passionate problem solver - You love digging deep and brainstorming with colleagues in order to come up with the best solution for a problem
You are excited about AI - You are enthusiastic about how AI is transforming software engineering and enjoy exploring new tools and models, applying them thoughtfully and responsibly to improve the way you build software

Eligibility Requirements

Penultimate year or Final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree, at any stage in your PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
Computing and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Fundamentals
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Desire to learn and grow with Airwallex as a technologist

Life at Airwallex as an Intern

💸 Competitive rewards: Industry-leading salaries and benefits

🥗 On-site snacks & drinks, lunch credits

🎂 Enjoy a paid day off on your birthday to celebrate YOU

🏢 Prime location: Centrally located office for easy access

Application & Assessment process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We'll keep you updated throughout the process, and appreciate your patience while we carefully review every application.

The Recruitment Process Includes

Application submission including your current resume and academic transcript
Online technical assessment
Talent screen
Live Code Interview
Hiring Manager interview

About

As part of the interview process, we are interested not only in your coding fundamentals, but also in how you think about using AI in engineering. Depending on the stage, we may assess:

How you approach problem solving with and without AI assistance
Your ability to evaluate, refine or challenge AI-generated suggestions
Your curiosity about new models, tools and practical use cases

We are not looking for candidates who simply use AI tools. We are looking for future engineers who can use them thoughtfully, critically and effectively.

Requirements:
Please provide us with the latest PDF copies of your transcript and CV outlining when you finish your studies when applying

Applications close: 18 Sep 2026 2359 SGT

If the career website link does not work, please use this application link instead: Alternative application link

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. Project Description:

Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.
