o Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
o Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
o Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
o Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
o Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
o Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
o Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
o Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
o Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
o Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
o Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
o Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.
Mandatory Skills Description:

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.
Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

o Knowledge Linux OS variants (Ubuntu, Debian).
o CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab, or similar) and issue tracking tools (JIRA, Confluence).
o Knowledge of STC Tcl API or legacy Tcl/HLTAPI scripting (useful for migrating existing test suites to
Python).
o Familiarity with additional traffic generation or network testing tools (e.g., IXIA/Keysight, Wireshark, Iperf).

jobs.title: Technical Delivery Engineer
jobs.description:
About Sedna:

Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

About the role

Every Sedna product we sell is semi-custom. That is a strength commercially and a bottleneck in delivery. Our Delivery Managers are excellent at taking a customer from signature to live, but the technical edge cases inherent in a semi-custom build, a tagging model that won't behave, an integration that won't connect, a configuration question with no standard answer, currently pull them off the critical path while they wait on other teams to help.

This role removes that bottleneck. You are the technical engine inside the Delivery team, a hands-on, broad-spectrum engineer whose job is to unblock our Delivery Managers on the pressing technical problems that today stall implementations. When a Delivery Manager hits a wall, you are the person who gets them through it: configuring, scripting, debugging integrations, untangling tagging logic, and answering the technical questions that would otherwise sit in a queue.

You sit inside Delivery, you report to the Head of Delivery, and you are measured on the same outcomes as the rest of the team. That is deliberate: your incentives are aligned with speed to value. You win when the team ships launches faster, not when a ticket is closed somewhere else. The result is fewer external dependencies, fewer escalations, and implementations that stop stalling on technical unknowns.

What this role is, and what it isn't

This role IS

A force multiplier for eight Delivery Managers, you make the whole team faster.
A generalist who gets hands on the build: config, tagging, auto-taggers, integrations, APIs.
The first line of technical resolution, so problems get solved in-team.
An engineer with a delivery mindset and delivery incentives.

This role is NOT

Not another Implementation Manager with an engineering title.
Not the owner of a personal portfolio of accounts.
Not a project manager. Delivery Managers keep owning the customer relationship and timeline.
Not a Product or Engineering function. You live and are measured inside Delivery.

What you'll do

Unblock the Delivery team's technical roadblocks

Be the first technical resolver for the Delivery Managers. When an implementation hits a technical wall, a configuration edge case, a tagging model that won't behave, an integration that won't connect, an "is this a bug or a config?" question, you are who they come to, and you get them moving again.
Get hands on the build directly: workflows, mailboxes, key settings, category and job tags, auto-taggers, and the scripts or API calls needed to make a semi-custom solution actually work in practice.
Hold the escalation boundary. Decide what can be solved inside Delivery versus what genuinely needs Engineering, and when it does, go directly to engineering leads with a problem that is specified, reproducible and immediately actionable, so it gets resolved quickly instead of sitting in a ticket queue.

Turn one-off fixes into team capability

Turn recurring roadblocks into reusable assets, playbooks, templates, tooling, snippets, so the same problem never stops a Delivery Manager twice.
Level up the team's technical skillset. As Delivery verticalises, you help diversify the skills on the team so that more can be handled in-house over time.
Feed recurring patterns back to Product and Engineering so root causes are fixed at source rather than re-solved on every account.

Configuration & solution work across the estate

Support post-signature solution design and configuration for new customers across Email and VMS, translating signed scope into a working build alongside the Delivery Manager who owns the account.
Review live customers where a workflow isn't delivering value, category tag overload, job tag pollution, sub-voyage tagging, mis-operated setups, and produce an implementable redesign the Delivery team can land.
Run configuration reviews covering key settings, mailbox configuration and auto-tagger logic; diagnose and resolve tagging issues raised as customer priorities.

Integrations & internal technical escalation

Act as the internal technical point of contact for email, VMS, API and job-reference integrations, troubleshooting connections to third-party chartering and voyage-management systems, and writing specifications Engineering can build against.
Be the credible link to Engineering when a Delivery Manager needs technical backup, able to explain the problem clearly to engineering leads and get it prioritised, including in difficult or high-pressure situations.

You will report into Delivery and work day to day with Delivery Managers, Customer Success and Engineering leads.

In your first 90 days, you can expect:

This role is hands on from day one. The first three months are structured to move you from learning our platform to owning technical unblocking and solution support outright.

Weeks 1–4: Get deep on the Sedna products, product architecture, the tagging model, auto-taggers and the integrations relevant to each project. Shadow live implementations and configuration reviews, and meet the Delivery, Customer Success and Engineering teams.
Weeks 4–8: Take ownership of your first configuration reviews and workflow redesigns for existing customers, supported by the Delivery Manager. Pick up named technical contact duties on one live integration.
Weeks 8–12: Own post-signature solution design and configuration for new customers end to end, and lead discovery for new teams joining existing accounts.
By day 90: You have a documented, repeatable approach to solution design, configuration review and integration requirements gathering that the wider Delivery team can use, and measurably faster time-to-live on the accounts you own.

Success Metrics

Time to live: Driving enhanced average implementation times down on accounts your role is involved in, goal to reduce time to live by 10%. Measured from kickoff to go-live.
Solution design turnaround: SDD drafted and customer-approved within 10 working days of kickoff.
Launches supported: carries technical ownership on 8–10 concurrent launches without becoming the constraint.
First-time-right configuration: under 20% of launches require post-go-live reconfiguration of tagging or workflow. Baseline needs established in month one.

What We're Looking For:

Essential experience:

5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role, exposure to maritime, shipping, commodities or logistics, solutions engineering, technical implementation, integration or professional services in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
Hands-on configuration: A track record of configuring enterprise software for customers, not only specifying it. You are comfortable owning the build.
Integrations: Practical experience with APIs, data mapping and third-party system integrations, and the ability to write requirements that customers or other third parties can act on.
Solution design: Able to run discovery with business users, understand how they actually work, and design for the underlying problem rather than the stated request.
Engineering credibility: Confident engaging engineering leads and technical stakeholders directly, including in difficult or high-pressure conversations, to get issues explained clearly and prioritised.
Independent operator: Comfortable holding named accountability across multiple accounts with competing priorities, and clear on what to escalate.
Bias to repeatability: An instinct to turn one-off solutions into templates, standards and documentation.
Advanced knowledge of MS Entra ID and MS Graph is a plus.

Our Values:

Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.
Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.
We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.
By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

Execute With Focus

We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.
Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.
We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.
Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

Work Together, Win Together

Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.
We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.
Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.
By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.title: Développeur Power Platform et Azure — C#
jobs.description:
Développeur Power Platform et Azure — C#

Renens (VD) · 80 à 100 % · Sur place au début · Télétravail possible par la suite

Nous cherchons un(e) développeur(se) pour rejoindre notre équipe Business Solutions à Renens.
Le poste se situe à la croisée de Power Platform, Azure et C# / .NET
.
Vous construisez les éléments que les produits standards ne couvrent pas suffisamment bien : une application métier dans Power Apps, une automatisation avec Power Automate, une API, un service d’intégration, une Azure Function ou un traitement qui doit faire communiquer plusieurs systèmes.
Chez nous, le développement est rarement isolé du reste du projet. Vous comprenez pourquoi quelque chose doit être construit, vous échangez avec les consultants et parfois directement avec le client, puis vous voyez votre travail partir réellement en production.

Ce que vous allez faire

Selon les projets, vous serez amené(e) à :
développer en C# et .NET
;
construire des applications avec Power Apps
;
créer des automatisations avec Power Automate
;
développer des composants et services exécutés dans Azure ;
créer et consommer des API ;
intégrer des applications qui n’ont pas été conçues pour fonctionner ensemble ;
travailler avec Dataverse et les services Microsoft autour de la Power Platform ;
utiliser des services Azure tels que Functions, Service Bus, Logic Apps ou les mécanismes d’identité ;
participer aux choix techniques avec les consultants et les architectes ;
tester, déployer et maintenir ce que vous développez ;
intervenir sur des applications réellement utilisées au quotidien par les clients.

Vous pourrez aussi être amené(e) à reprendre du code existant, améliorer une architecture ou remplacer une solution devenue trop complexe par quelque chose de plus simple.

Ce que nous cherchons

Le plus important pour nous est d’avoir déjà développé et livré du code C# / .NET qui a été utilisé en production
.
Le secteur dans lequel vous l’avez fait nous importe peu.
Nous cherchons également quelqu’un qui a déjà dépassé le stade de la découverte avec la Power Platform. Vous n’avez pas besoin de connaître absolument tous les composants, mais nous voulons que Power Apps ou Power Automate soient déjà des outils que vous avez utilisés sur un vrai besoin.
Une première expérience avec Azure est également importante. Vous devez comprendre ce que signifie faire tourner une application ou un traitement dans Azure, gérer des identités, des échanges entre services ou des traitements asynchrones.
Et surtout, nous apprécions les développeurs capables de dire :
« Ça, on ne devrait probablement pas le développer. »

Savoir quand utiliser le standard, quand configurer et quand coder fait partie du métier.

Ce que ce poste n’est pas

Ce n’est pas un poste de développement de sites web.
Les applications que nous réalisons sont principalement des applications métier
, des intégrations et des services utilisés par des entreprises et des organisations.
Ce n’est pas non plus un poste dans lequel vous recevrez uniquement des tickets déjà découpés par quelqu’un d’autre. Vous serez proche des consultants, des choix de solution et des personnes qui utilisent réellement ce que vous construisez.
Et vous ne travaillerez pas forcément sur la même technologie pendant trois ans. Les projets changent, les besoins aussi, et c’est justement ce qui rend le poste intéressant.

Travailler chez Lambert Consulting

Lambert Consulting est une société informatique suisse basée à Renens.
Nous travaillons principalement autour de l’écosystème Microsoft : Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Teams, téléphonie et Contact Center
.
L’équipe Business Solutions réalise des applications métier, des automatisations et des intégrations pour des clients suisses, avec des projets qui peuvent aller d’un besoin très ciblé à des environnements beaucoup plus larges.
Nous avons une organisation assez directe : les personnes qui conçoivent et développent les solutions sont proches des clients et des décisions prises sur les projets.
Cela permet aussi de voir assez rapidement le résultat de son travail.
Quand une application ou un service est mis en production, vous savez qui l’utilise et pourquoi il a été construit.

Organisation du travail

Le poste est basé à Renens
et peut être occupé à 80 à 100 %
.
Nous privilégions une présence sur place au début. Pour nous, c’est la manière la plus efficace de découvrir les projets, les clients et la façon dont l’équipe travaille.
Le télétravail peut ensuite être introduit progressivement.
Le français courant est nécessaire.
L’anglais n’est pas une condition pour le poste.

Intéressé(e) ?

Pas besoin d’une longue lettre de motivation.
Si vous avez du code public, un GitHub ou un projet que vous pouvez nous montrer, vous pouvez simplement nous envoyer le lien.
Sinon, expliquez-nous avec vos mots ce que vous avez construit, les technologies utilisées et ce qui tournait réellement en production.

jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud Solution Architect – Microsoft Azure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört.

DAS KANNST DU BEWEGEN

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.
Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Du konzipierst Azure Landing Zones und gestaltest die technische Basis für Cloud-Transformationen – inklusive Management Groups, Subscriptions, Networking, Identity, Governance und Security.
Azure Migration & Modernisierung: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Planung und Umsetzung von Migrationen nach Azure und entwickelst bestehende IT-Landschaften gezielt weiter.
Hybrid Cloud & Networking: Du konzipierst hybride Architekturen und verbindest bestehende On-Premises-Umgebungen sicher mit Azure – beispielsweise mit Azure Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints und Azure DNS.
Security & Identity: Du integrierst Security von Beginn an in deine Architektur und arbeitest unter anderem mit Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy und Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Du automatisierst den Aufbau von Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit Technologien wie Terraform oder Bicep und integrierst diese in moderne CI/CD-Prozesse mit GitHub oder Azure DevOps.
Cloud-native Lösungen: Du berätst unsere Kunden auch beim Einsatz moderner Azure Services wie Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps oder Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.
Kundenberatung & Workshops: Du diskutierst Anforderungen auf Augenhöhe mit IT-Verantwortlichen und Architekten, moderierst Architektur- und Cloud-Workshops und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete technische Lösungen.
PreSales & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Microsoft-Team entwickelst du Lösungsansätze für neue Kundenprojekte und unterstützt bei Architekturkonzepten, Aufwandsschätzungen, Angeboten sowie Präsentationen.
Microsoft Ecosystem: Du arbeitest eng mit Microsoft und unseren internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und bringst neue Azure-Technologien und Best Practices aktiv in unsere Kundenprojekte ein.
Teamarbeit: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unser Microsoft Azure Portfolio weiter.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Azure-Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und der Konzeption sowie Umsetzung von Azure-basierten Kundenlösungen mit.
Infrastructure Know-how: Du verstehst klassische und moderne IT-Infrastrukturen und kennst dich insbesondere mit Cloud Networking, Compute, Storage, Identity, Security und hybriden Architekturen aus.
Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.
Security: Zero Trust, Identity & Access Management, Network Security, Governance und Cloud Security sind für dich integraler Bestandteil einer Architektur und keine nachgelagerten Themen.
Modernisierung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit Azure Migrate sowie mit PaaS-, Container- oder Kubernetes-basierten Architekturen gesammelt.
DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären, trittst beim Kunden sicher auf und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst gerne technische Verantwortung und möchtest Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern deren Umsetzung aktiv begleiten.
Zertifizierungen: Microsoft Azure Zertifizierungen wie Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) sind ein Plus – oder du bist bereit, entsprechende Zertifizierungen bei uns zu erlangen.
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, gemeinschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Lerne und wachse mit uns: Mit über 400 Trainingsangeboten und unserer digitalen Lernplattform unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Gemeinsame Events (z.B. Sport-Weekend und die jährliche Fortbildungsreise eduCamp), Welcome Days, Firmenläufe stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und lassen dich von Anfang an Teil des Teams sein.
Engagement, das belohnt wird: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus – mit Prämien für Empfehlungen, Vorträge, die Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns – auch im Home-Office. Arbeiten in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich (80-100%). Zum wiederholten Mal wurden wir zu einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gekürt! Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

ÜBER EMERGO

emergo technologies ist ein Innsbrucker Technologieunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf Softwareanwendungen im medizinischen Umfeld. Wir arbeiten wissenschaftsnah, eng mit Forschungspartnern, und bringen neue Technologien in den praktischen Einsatz – bis hin zu regulierter Medizinprodukte-Software. Unsere Kunden setzen langfristig auf uns: Wir begleiten Projekte von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis in den Betrieb. Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz, und Entwickler:innen verantworten Projekte von der Architektur bis zur Übergabe beim Kunden.

DIE ROLLE

Als Senior Developer / Experienced Builder übernimmst du Projekte technisch von Anfang bis Ende: Du entwirfst die Architektur, triffst die Technologieentscheidungen, setzt um und bist die technische Ansprechperson für den Kunden. Wir bauen unser Team gerade aus und suchen Menschen, die über den Tellerrand schauen – über das eigene Arbeitspaket hinaus bis zu Kunde, Produkt und Vertrieb.
Coding-Harnesses wie Claude Code sind bei uns fester Bestandteil der Entwicklung – und ihre Rolle wird weiter wachsen. Wir sehen darin keinen Trend, sondern eine dauerhafte Veränderung der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Entwickler:innen, die das als Chance begreifen: Du gestaltest, wie Mensch und Werkzeug zusammenarbeiten, leitest den Entwicklungsprozess mit diesen Werkzeugen und sorgst dafür, dass die Qualität des Ergebnisses stimmt.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Du entwirfst Softwarearchitekturen und Softwaredesigns für Kunden- und Produktprojekte und dokumentierst die zugrunde liegenden Entscheidungen.
Du setzt diese Architekturen eigenständig um – selbst und mit Coding-Harnesses.
Du gestaltest und leitest den Entwicklungsprozess mit Coding-Harnesses: Du legst fest, welche Aufgaben an die Werkzeuge gehen, und gibst Kontext, Architektur und Vorgaben so vor, dass sie verlässlich umgesetzt werden.
Du integrierst die Qualitätssicherung in diesen Prozess: automatisierte Tests, Review von generiertem Code, statische Analyse und CI-Prüfungen – sodass jede Änderung nachvollziehbar geprüft ist, egal ob sie von Mensch oder Werkzeug stammt.
Du wählst Technologien, Frameworks und Bibliotheken aus und begründest deine Auswahl.
Du leitest Projekte technisch gegenüber dem Kunden: Anforderungen klären, Änderungen steuern, Ergebnisse übergeben.
Du führst das Entwicklungsteam im Projekt fachlich: Arbeitspakete verteilen, Code Reviews durchführen, Junior-Entwickler:innen anleiten.
Du arbeitest mit Marketing & Sales zusammen: Machbarkeit einschätzen, Aufwände schätzen, technische Inhalte für Angebote und Referenzen liefern.
Du stellst sicher, dass Sicherheitsanforderungen in Architektur und Umsetzung korrekt abgebildet sind.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Mindset
Selbständig: Du arbeitest ohne Detailvorgaben und holst Entscheidungen dort ein, wo sie nötig sind.
Ambitioniert: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Projekte und Produkte weiterbringen.
Organisiert: Du planst deine Arbeit und die deines Teams nachvollziehbar und hältst Zusagen ein.
Konsistent: Du lieferst verlässliche Qualität – in Code, Dokumentation und Kommunikation.
Kreativ: Du findest für neue Problemstellungen eigene Lösungswege.

Erfahrung und Fachkenntnisse
Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
Erfahrung in der Erstellung und eigenständigen Umsetzung von Softwarearchitekturen
Praktische Erfahrung mit Coding-Harnesses wie Claude Code im professionellen Einsatz – und Freude daran, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätssicherung rund um diese Werkzeuge zu gestalten
Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung mit direktem Kundenkontakt
Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Entwicklungsteams
Security: Kenntnis relevanter kryptografischer Primitive (z. B. symmetrische und asymmetrische Verschlüsselung, Hashfunktionen, MACs, digitale Signaturen, Schlüsselaustausch) und ihrer korrekten Anwendung (z. B. TLS, Passwort-Hashing, Schlüsselverwaltung)
Erfahrung im Embedded-Bereich ist von Vorteil

Technologiestack
Hosting-Betriebssystem: Linux
Programmiersprachen: Python, SQL (relationale Datenbanken), JavaScript/TypeScript mit React
Programmierparadigmen: fundierte Kenntnis objektorientierter, funktionaler und imperativer Programmierung
Tools: Coding-Harnesses wie Claude Code; macOS als Entwicklungsgerät

Sprachen
Deutsch und Englisch auf professionellem Niveau

WAS WIR BIETEN

Sehr gutes Grundgehalt
Erfolgsabhängige Überzahlung
Intrapreneur-Modell: ein klarer Weg, eigene Ideen bis zur Ausgründung weiterzuentwickeln
Flache Hierarchien und direkte Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung
Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
Arbeitsplatz in Innsbruck, Homeoffice möglich

GEHALT

Für diese Position gilt der Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte von Unternehmen im Bereich Dienstleistungen in der automatischen Datenverarbeitung und Informationstechnik (IT-KV), Beschäftigungsgruppe ST2. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. To support our scale, we are transforming our Engineering Platform into a state-of-the-art Internal Developer Platform (IDP) built on modern principles and AI-augmented workflows — with a North Star of evolving it into an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) where human engineers and AI agents build software side by side, safely and at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer
— Internal Developer Platform
to help build and run that platform and the AI-First Delivery capabilities on top of it. This is the modern evolution of the DevOps Engineer role: you won't run a ticket queue — you'll treat the platform as a product, own a capability area end to end, and ship the golden paths, guardrails and automation that let our Stream-Aligned Teams (and their agents) deliver faster and more safely. You'll work closely with our Platform Product Manager and Senior Cloud Architect — turning platform strategy and prioritised needs into working capabilities.

The Technical Context

You will build and operate the capabilities that make up the IDP.

Core Stack: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), containers (Docker); services in C#/.NET and Node.js
IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Helm, and a move toward GitOps with ArgoCD
CI/CD: Evolution from Azure DevOps toward GitHub Actions, modernizing pipelines (not a blind "lift and shift")
Integration: Azure API Management, Apollo Federation/GraphOS, n8n
Security: Azure Entra ID, SonarQube, Azure Policy, Key Vault
Observability: NewRelic and Grafana (proactive SRE and business-value metrics)
Developer Experience & AI: Backstage, our Technology Framework (policies/standards as executable AI context), MCP, and AI-driven development (e.g. Cursor AI, GitHub Spec-Kit)

What You'll Do

Build and operate the IDP: golden paths, self-service templates, the developer portal (Backstage) and IDP catalog, and guardrails that keep teams compliant by default (guardrails, not gates)
Own CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions; help drive the migration off Azure DevOps; implement GitOps (ArgoCD) for AKS — rethinking deployments rather than lifting-and-shifting custom tasks
Provision cloud infrastructure as code: evolve Azure (AKS, networking, databases, APIM, Key Vault, Entra ID) with Terraform and Helm; manage reliability and cost (FinOps)
Improve observability & reliability: instrument systems (NewRelic, Grafana), define SLOs, reduce operational toil, and drive monitoring-cost accountability
Advance AI-First Delivery and the ADP: build agent-ready context (MCP, the Technology Framework), path definitions (e.g. validate-change, PR-review), and agent governance (non-human identity, sandboxed execution, evaluation, agent observability)
Own a capability area end to end and set the standard: take a platform domain (e.g. CI/CD & GitOps, or cloud foundations) from design to run, define the reference patterns and ADRs others build on, and raise the bar through code review, mentoring and pairing
Build for adoption, like a product: design capabilities around real internal customers, write docs that work, and gather feedback from the teams you serve — so the platform is genuinely the easiest, safest path. Partner with the Platform Product Manager on priorities, and let adoption, DORA and DevEx metrics (not ticket counts) tell you what to improve next

Requirements

A full-stack software engineering background (prerequisite): you've built and shipped production software yourself (e.g. in C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, Go or similar) — so you bring genuine developer empathy for the engineers you build the platform for, and you design self-service that you'd actually want to use
Senior-level experience: typically 5+ years building and operating cloud platforms or infrastructure, including owning a capability area end to end and setting patterns / mentoring other engineers
Cloud & Kubernetes: strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AWS/GCP transferable) and Kubernetes (AKS): networking, storage, managed databases
Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Terraform and Helm; GitOps with ArgoCD or similar
CI/CD: modern pipelines (GitHub Actions ideal); experience migrating from other CI systems a plus
Observability & reliability: metrics/logs/traces, SLOs and error budgets; security/compliance as code (policy-as-code, secrets management, identity basics)
Product mindset for internal tooling: developer empathy, self-service design, guardrails not gates
AI-First: you already work with AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor) and are excited to build golden paths and agent workflows, not just consume them
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

API platform experience (Azure APIM, Apollo Federation/GraphOS) and developer-portal experience (Backstage)
Exposure to agentic/LLM tooling, MCP, GitHub Spec-Kit, or building AI developer workflows
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven platform contributions
Familiarity with Team Topologies, DORA, SPACE / DX Core 4, CNCF platform maturity; workflow automation (n8n) and FinOps

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption: teams/services on golden paths; self-service actions; time-to-first-deploy for a new service
Delivery (DORA): deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change-failure rate, time to restore
Developer experience: internal NPS/satisfaction, support-ticket trend, golden-path coverage
Reliability & cost: SLOs met; cloud and monitoring spend under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

Platform engineering gets more
valuable in the AI era, not less: the platform does :90% of the work, the model :10%. You'll help move engineering effort from one-off delivery toward owning, running and evolving the platform and its agents
— the scarce, high-leverage work of the next decade — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

Do you have a passion about implementing and improving Manufacturing Execution Systems and Manufacturing IT? Would you like to work for a growing global company with an international culture?

As part of the MES Team and project Teams, the Senior MES Presales Engineer
makes a qualitative contribution to the project within their area of expertise by working independently. The aim is to help ensure that the delivery of a project is completed properly within the predetermined time and scope.

By engaging with customers and prospects, you identify their business challenges, expectations, and operational needs. You help define effective and scalable MES solutions and translate these requirements into technical proposals, solution architectures, and implementation strategies.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO

Insurtech · España · Presencial/Híbrido Igualada
Desde Kiliia estamos buscando un Head of Engineering y futuro CTO para un proyecto insurtech en el que estamos trabajando.
Sobre el proyecto

Son la primera MGA española especializada en trabajar la confianza entre la empresa y el trabajador. Están construyendo el producto desde cero — tecnología, producto y regulación — con el objetivo de lanzar en enero 2027. Buscamos a la persona que lidere y construya toda la capa tecnológica de la compañía.
El rol

Como Head of Engineering / Futuro CTO liderarás el área de ingeniería y tecnología, definiendo junto al equipo fundador la visión técnica del producto y la arquitectura a largo plazo. En tu día a día coordinarás equipos de desarrollo, priorizarás el roadmap técnico, asegurarás la calidad del software y la entrega a tiempo de los proyectos. Colaborarás estrechamente con producto y negocio para alinear las decisiones técnicas con las necesidades de la empresa, y participarás en la selección de talento y en la construcción de una cultura de ingeniería sólida.
No buscamos a alguien que ejecute tareas. Buscamos al arquitecto técnico del proyecto: la persona que en 3-5 años sea el CTO de una compañía regulada con miles de pólizas bajo gestión.
Hoy el stack es React + Python + PostgreSQL. La arquitectura y las decisiones técnicas estratégicas serán tuyas.
Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, con modalidad híbrida. El puesto está ubicado en Igualada y parte del trabajo se puede realizar desde casa.
Lo que necesitamos

Obligatorio:
Full stack real — frontend en React y backend en Python
PostgreSQL y diseño de bases de datos relacionales
Haber construido y llevado a producción al menos un producto digital desde cero
Haber trabajado en startups, no solo en corporates
Experiencia en proyectos de datos: modelado, optimización, analítica y modelos predictivos
Usar IA en el día a día como herramienta de desarrollo — no como concepto, como práctica real
Capacidad para comunicar ideas técnicas con claridad a perfiles no técnicos
Experiencia en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban) y herramientas de colaboración (Git, CI/CD, Jira)
Entre 5 y 10 años de experiencia

Valorado muy positivamente:
Experiencia en fintech, insurtech o healthtech
Haber diseñado arquitecturas de datos orientadas a scoring o underwriting
Conocimiento de RGPD y cumplimiento normativo
Haber liderado equipos pequeños (2-5 personas)
Formación en ingeniería informática, telecomunicaciones o disciplinas técnicas afines
Entender de negocio y poder hablar con inversores

Lo que ofrecemos

Un proyecto ambicioso en una categoría de producto sin competencia real en España. Están regulados, con carrier firmado y primeros clientes en pipeline — no es una idea, es una compañía en construcción.
Equity desde el inicio para quien quiera crecer con el proyecto. Y potencial de internacionalización real: el modelo es replicable en cualquier mercado europeo con alta tasa de temporalidad laboral.
Si buscas construir algo que no existe y dejar huella en un mercado, hablemos.
Cómo aplicar

Escríbenos directamente con un ejemplo concreto de algo que hayas construido y llevado a producción.

Actuará como referente técnico en la construcción de plataformas empresariales de IA, garantizando escalabilidad, seguridad, resiliencia y alineamiento con la estrategia tecnológica corporativa.

Este perfil combinará conocimientos avanzados de arquitectura empresarial, plataformas cloud y ecosistemas de datos con experiencia específica en servicios de IA, MLOps y plataformas de desarrollo basadas en Azure
y Databricks
.

Arquitectura de Infraestructura para IA

Diseñar la arquitectura objetivo de la plataforma corporativa de IA.
Definir los componentes tecnológicos necesarios para soportar casos de uso de IA, GenAI y agentes inteligentes.
Establecer arquitecturas de referencia para entornos de desarrollo, pruebas y producción.
Garantizar la integración de soluciones de IA con los sistemas corporativos existentes.

Plataformas Cloud y Datos

Diseñar y evolucionar arquitecturas basadas en Microsoft Azure.
Definir patrones de arquitectura para plataformas de datos e inteligencia artificial utilizando Azure y Databricks.

Asegurar la escalabilidad y optimización de costes de las plataformas tecnológicas.

AI Platform Engineering & MLOps

Diseñar pipelines para entrenamiento, despliegue, monitorización y gobierno de modelos.
Establecer estándares de observabilidad, monitorización y gestión del ciclo de vida de modelos de IA.
Colaborar con equipos de Data Science, AI Engineering y DevOps para industrializar soluciones.

Seguridad y Gobierno

Definir arquitecturas seguras para el consumo de modelos y datos.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares de ciberseguridad, privacidad y gobierno del dato.
Diseñar mecanismos de control de acceso, cifrado, auditoría y trazabilidad.
Promover la adopción de principios de Responsible AI y AI Governance.

Liderazgo Técnico

Actuar como referente arquitectónico en programas estratégicos de IA.
Liderar revisiones de arquitectura y decisiones tecnológicas.
Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y plataformas del mercado.
Contribuir a actividades de preventa, definición de ofertas y roadmaps tecnológicos.

Imprescindibles

Más de 5 años de experiencia en arquitectura tecnológica y cloud.
Experiencia demostrable en Microsoft Azure.
Conocimiento avanzado de Databricks.
Experiencia en plataformas empresariales de datos y analítica.
Conocimiento de arquitecturas distribuidas, APIs y microservicios.
Experiencia en DevOps, CI/CD e Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep o equivalente).
Conocimiento de seguridad cloud e integración con entornos corporativos.

Valorable

Experiencia con Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Cognitive Services y servicios de IA generativa.
Experiencia en arquitecturas RAG, agentes IA y sistemas multiagente.
Conocimiento de Kubernetes y entornos containerizados.
Experiencia en MLOps, LLMOps y gobernanza de modelos.
Certificaciones Microsoft Azure Architect o Databricks.

Competencias

Visión estratégica y capacidad de diseño end-to-end.
Pensamiento arquitectónico y orientación a estándares.
Liderazgo técnico e influencia sobre equipos multidisciplinares.
Capacidad para comunicar conceptos complejos a audiencias técnicas y de negocio.
Orientación a resultados y mejora continua.
Capacidad para trabajar en entornos complejos y de transformación tecnológica.

Objetivo del Rol

Construir y evolucionar la Enterprise AI Infrastructure Layer
, proporcionando una plataforma tecnológica robusta, segura y escalable que permita acelerar la adopción de Inteligencia Artificial, Analítica Avanzada y soluciones basadas en IA Generativa en toda la organización.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer (Full Stack / Java)
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARAVELO

Airlines have spent decades selling one trip at a time. At Caravelo, we help them build recurring relationships with their customers instead.

We build the technology behind airline subscription products used by carriers around the world, combining SaaS, payments, booking systems and airline integrations in one platform.

Our Product & Platform teams build the common technology. Our Professional Services team makes it work in the real world for each airline.

That is where this role comes in.

THE MISSION

Caravelo has one platform, but no two airline implementations are exactly the same.

As a Customer Solutions Engineer in our Professional Services team
, your job is to bridge that gap.

You will learn how our core platform can be configured, integrated and extended, and use those capabilities to create the implementation each customer needs — without modifying or forking the core platform.

For every airline, we build a customer plugin
that wraps the specific integrations, extensions, business rules and behaviours required to make Caravelo fit naturally into that customer's technology landscape.

Working closely with Project Managers and customer stakeholders, you will understand requirements, identify the peculiarities of each implementation and decide how best to solve them: configuration, extension, integration or, when justified, a dedicated service or module.

The goal is simple:

Make every customer rollout feel unique while keeping it cleanly built on top of a common, scalable platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bring customers live

You will be one of the engineers turning a signed customer into a working production implementation.

That means:
Understand customer requirements together with the Project Manager.
Translate business and technical requirements into a concrete implementation.
Configure and extend the Caravelo platform using the capabilities provided by our Product & Platform teams.
Build and maintain the customer plugin that contains customer-specific logic and integrations.
Take implementations through development, testing, launch and production stabilisation.

You'll work closely with our Platform and Product engineers, who will provide the documentation, tooling and training needed to understand the core platform and its extension points.

Your job is not to rebuild what already exists. It is to understand the platform deeply enough to use it intelligently and extend it where necessary.

Solve integration problems

Airlines have complex technology ecosystems.

Some systems are modern. Others have been running successfully for decades.

You will make them work together.

Depending on the customer, you may integrate Caravelo with:
Airline reservation and passenger service systems.
Payment gateways and payment infrastructure.
Identity and authentication platforms.
CRM and communication systems.
Loyalty platforms.
Data platforms.
Internal airline APIs.
Third-party and legacy systems.

Sometimes the solution will be straightforward.

Sometimes the API documentation will be incomplete, the behaviour will differ between environments, or two systems will have fundamentally different assumptions.

You should enjoy figuring those problems out.

Build customer-specific extensions

Most customer needs should be solved using the common platform.

But not all of them will be.

When there is a genuine gap, you may:
Build an additional connector.
Extend an existing workflow.
Create customer-specific business logic.
Develop an isolated service or module.
Implement data transformation or migration processes.

The challenge is knowing when to configure, when to extend and when to build something new.

We want engineers who can solve the customer problem without creating unnecessary complexity.

Own the implementation beyond go-live

Our work does not stop when a customer launches.

Customer systems evolve, vendors change and integrations eventually need to move with them.

You will help:
Investigate and debug production issues.
Maintain customer-specific integrations.
Upgrade connectors as external systems evolve.
Support customers through technical migrations.
Replace or introduce integrations while keeping the service running.
Improve existing implementations when better platform capabilities become available.

For example, an airline may decide to replace its payment gateway.

Your work could involve enabling the new payment connector in Caravelo, adapting the customer plugin, helping define the migration approach for existing payment tokens, validating the transition and supporting the rollout together with the Project Manager and customer team.

These are not theoretical architecture exercises. They are real production systems with real customers behind them.

Work across the stack when needed

Your centre of gravity will be Java and backend engineering.

But customer implementations do not always respect stack boundaries.

You should be comfortable following a feature or problem wherever it goes: backend services, APIs, integrations, databases, scripts, data migrations or occasional frontend changes in Vue.

You do not need to be a frontend specialist.

You do need to be comfortable enough to understand the problem, use AI-assisted development effectively and validate that the result is production-quality.

Use AI as an engineering tool

We actively use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar assistants.

You will use them for things like:
Implementation.
Exploring unfamiliar code.
Writing and extending tests.
Debugging.
Refactoring.
Documentation.
Working with APIs and integrations.
Accelerating occasional frontend work.

We are particularly interested in Spec-Driven Development: defining clearly what needs to be built before asking AI to help implement it.

AI should make you faster. It should not replace engineering judgment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You are succeeding in this role when:
You can take a customer requirement and turn it into a clean, production-ready solution.
Customers launch successfully without unnecessary changes to the core platform.
Customer-specific behaviour remains well isolated and maintainable.
Integrations are observable, reliable and understandable by engineers other than their original author.
You can diagnose complex problems across Caravelo and customer systems.
You understand when to configure the platform, when to extend it and when custom development is genuinely necessary.
You become increasingly independent in understanding new customer technology landscapes.
Migrations and changes to existing integrations can be delivered without destabilising the customer's service.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have:

Strong professional experience building production software in Java, with solid backend engineering fundamentals.
Experience designing and integrating APIs, distributed services and cloud-based systems.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, especially when working across multiple systems or external dependencies.
Good understanding of testing, CI/CD, databases, observability and production software quality.
Comfortable understanding an existing platform and extending it cleanly rather than rebuilding from scratch.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Project Managers, engineers and technical customer stakeholders.

Nice to have:
Experience in Professional Services, implementation engineering, solutions engineering or customer-facing technical delivery.
Experience integrating enterprise or legacy systems, particularly in complex customer environments.
Experience with payments, payment gateways, data migrations or other business-critical integrations.
Experience in travel technology, airlines, reservation systems or similarly integration-heavy industries.
Familiarity with the technologies listed in our stack, especially Vue/Nuxt, Couchbase or Datadog.
Experience working in security-, compliance- or reliability-sensitive environments.

OUR STACK

You do not need to arrive knowing every technology we use.

Some of the technologies you may encounter include:

Java · SpringBoot · Vue.js · Nuxt · Couchbase · PostgreSQL · AWS · Datadog · Gitlab · Docker · Opentofu · Claude Code · Cursor

More important than matching every technology is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, investigate how things work and build reliable solutions around them.

THE KIND OF ENGINEER WHO TENDS TO ENJOY THIS ROLE

This role may be a good fit if you like engineering problems where the answer is not always obvious.

You enjoy understanding how systems behave, not just implementing predefined tickets.

You are comfortable opening documentation for an unfamiliar API, talking through requirements with a Project Manager, tracing a strange production issue across several systems and then writing the code that solves it.

You appreciate good architecture, but you are pragmatic.

And when confronted with a 15-year-old airline system that behaves differently from its documentation, your reaction is closer to “interesting” than “that's someone else's problem.”

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary with a clear progression framework.
Flexible working hours.
Barcelona-based hybrid model: 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home.
Tax-efficient benefits including private health insurance, restaurant and transport cards, and kindergarten support.
Budget for training and conferences.
Regular company events and celebrations.
23 days of annual leave.
Exposure to complex airline technology environments around the world.
The opportunity to work across software engineering, integrations and real customer implementations.
Meaningful ownership: you will see the systems you build go from requirements to production.

INTERESTED?

If you enjoy solving complex integration problems, getting customers live and making different systems work together without turning every implementation into a one-off project, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply and tell us about a difficult integration, migration or production problem you've solved.

jobs.title: Platform Product Manager - Platform Shared Services
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. Behind every product team sit the shared technical services that the whole publishing platform depends on. Today these are Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Messaging (transactional email and GDPR-compliant consent) — representative examples of this kind of shared service, with the portfolio expected to grow over time. They are owned by our Platform Shared Services team, and we are looking for a Platform Product Manager to own their strategy and roadmap.

This is not an end-user product role. Your customers are Frontiers' own engineering teams (and, increasingly, the services and agents they build): you run IAM and Messaging as products, measured by adoption, developer experience, reliability, integration time, security posture and cost — not user-facing metrics. You'll form a delivery triad with the team's Platform Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers: you own the What and Why, they own the How.

The Technical Context

You will own the roadmap for the team's shared-service lines — today IAM and Messaging.

IAM: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (Ory Hydra), JWT authorization, fine-grained authz via a Permission API (Ory Keto), Azure APIM at the edge, OAuth client tooling, shared .NET libraries
Messaging: transactional/outreach email at scale (SendGrid, Mailgun), templating and A/B testing, deliverability (Everest, Uriports, Postmaster, SNDS), and a central GDPR consent authority (Subscription Management)
Core stack: C#/.NET services on Microsoft Azure + Kubernetes (AKS); event-driven with RabbitMQ and Kafka; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
Contracts as the product: REST + async APIs, JWT shape and scopes, consent semantics, versioning and backward compatibility — high blast radius, consumed org-wide
Observability & AI: New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana; the sub-department's AI-First Delivery tooling (Cursor, MCP, the Technology Framework as executable context) is available to the team

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the roadmap for IAM and Messaging — prioritising against internal engineering demand, security/compliance requirements and platform scalability, and slicing big initiatives into iterative, valuable releases
Turn engineering needs into clear specs and a prioritised backlog — translate requirements from stream-aligned teams into well-shaped work (PRDs/SDDs in git, following our Spec-Driven / AI-First Delivery practice)
Co-design with engineering — work lock-step with the Platform Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers on architecture trade-offs, API contracts and service-level requirements. This needs genuine technical fluency, not just business↔engineering translation
Own the service/API lifecycle — versioning strategy, deprecation planning and backward-compatibility decisions for services many teams depend on
Be the primary point of contact for internal "customers" integrating with IAM and Messaging — a developer-facing product function: discovery, onboarding, support model, and a feedback loop that actually changes the roadmap
Define and track success metrics — adoption by internal teams, reliability (SLAs/SLOs), integration/time-to-first-call, security posture, and cost
Partner with Security, Architecture and Infrastructure — ensure IAM and Messaging meet compliance and security standards (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent) and stay aligned with the Technology Framework
Communicate roadmap, trade-offs and priorities clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholder teams — manage expectations transparently, including a tactful, well-reasoned "not now"

Requirements

Experience: 5+ years in Technical / Platform Product Management or engineering leadership, a significant portion in technical, platform, or developer-facing product roles
Platform-as-a-product mindset: you build for internal engineering customers, not end users, and can prioritize a technical roadmap against competing engineering demands
Technical fluency (real): solid software-engineering fundamentals — enough to engage credibly in architecture discussions, read technical docs, system diagrams and API specs unaided, and reason about trade-offs
APIs as products: strong grasp of API design, versioning, documentation and lifecycle management (deprecation, backward compatibility)
Distributed-systems literacy: working knowledge of backend systems, messaging/event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS) and authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT)
Reliability & cloud awareness: SLAs/SLOs, uptime, latency; familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Education/background: Bachelor's in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical/technical experience — a technical/engineering background is preferred over a pure business/PM background given the hard technical requirements
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written).

Nice to Have

Demonstrated experience with authentication and/or messaging systems (strongly preferred)
Familiarity with GDPR / consent and email deliverability at scale
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), and modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven contributions to shared services
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants (Cursor, MCP)
Background in Scientific Publishing

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption & integration: number of teams/services on the supported IAM and Messaging paths; time-to-first-call for a new integration
Reliability: SLAs/SLOs met for the owned services; incident trend
Developer experience: internal satisfaction/NPS of consuming teams; support-request trend; quality and currency of contracts and docs
Security & compliance: posture against the Technology Framework (OAuth/JWT, GDPR consent); audit-readiness
Cost: run cost of the services (incl. email/deliverability spend) under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

IAM and Messaging are leverage
: get them right and every team at Frontiers ships faster and safer. You'll turn "plumbing" into genuine products — with real customers, contracts and adoption — at the exact moment AI is multiplying how much code (and how many integrations) those teams produce. All in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter .
